_doc: Recall-quality ground truth. Each case is a question a developer would ACTUALLY ask, paired with (a) DISTINCTIVE marker terms that only a genuinely correct answer would contain, and (b) a literal-keyword variant of the same query. The plain-vs-literal comparison is the experiment: if literal wins and plain loses, the semantic half of retrieval is not contributing and we are running keyword search wearing a semantic costume.
_markers_warning: Markers MUST be distinctive. A first draft used generic words ('deploy', 'schema', 'latency') and scored junk to-dos like 'deploy the changes to production' as correct answers — inflating the pass rate and flattering the system. If a marker would match a memory that does not actually ANSWER the question, it is too generic. The instrument must be able to return bad news.

cases.plain: what test runner does this repo use and why does bun test fail
cases.known_memory: The Runner uses vitest: bunx vitest run — bun test hangs silently (better-sqlite3 incompat)

cases.plain: how do we stop the capture code from seeing my API key
cases.literal: capture fork headers ProxyTeeEvent body bytes
cases.known_memory: Capture must never receive headers — ProxyTeeEvent = { chunk } | { end }

cases.plain: why did the proxy capture only save my question and not the answer
cases.literal: gzip compressed response capture assistant reply dropped
cases.known_memory: Anthropic gzips responses; the tee got 1f 8b and both parsers failed

cases.plain: my branch is far behind main with junk merge commits, what should I do
cases.literal: cherry-pick rebase stale branch behind main
cases.known_memory: Cherry-pick the one work commit onto fresh main; take the files not the history

cases.plain: I added a field to the envelope but it never reaches the database
cases.literal: zod strip mode unmodeled field silently deleted
cases.known_memory: zod default mode is strip: an unmodeled field is silently DELETED at parse

cases.plain: how do I release to production
cases.literal: release merge push v tag deploy-azure-prod workflow_run
cases.known_memory: release = merge + push v* tag, then STOP; prod deploy auto-fires on workflow_run

cases.plain: is it safe to kill node processes on this machine
cases.literal: taskkill image name pkill node eval daemon
cases.known_memory: NEVER kill by image name — the live daemon, Ollama, sibling agents share the box

cases.plain: is proxy capture turned on by default
cases.literal: proxy capture enabled default false opt-in
cases.known_memory: capture.enabled defaults false, independent of proxy.enabled

cases.plain: why would a spooled envelope silently disappear instead of erroring
cases.literal: spool drain safeParse quarantine poison capture_source enum
cases.known_memory: spool-drain's zod enum quarantined capture_source:'proxy' envelopes as poison

cases.plain: how much latency does the proxy add
cases.known_memory: 0.34ms p50 capture-off, ~0.4ms capture-on, vs a 10ms budget
